messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — we need to schedule a security/privacy/compliance review for the Payments Connect private deployment audit. Looking for a 60 -> 45 min slot next week to cover threat model updates, access recert, and audit artifact checklist. Who's available? Suggested pre-reads: https://redwood.internal/docs/payments-connect/sec-review and PR #412. Pinging @Alex Chen @Jordan Rivera @Leila Okafor.

Alex Chen: I'm available Tue/Wed mornings (PST). Can do 60m but happy to compress. I'll bring the threatmodel diff and the runtime network diagram.

Jordan Rivera: Prefer Wed 10:30–12:30 PST, or Thu afternoon. Can we trim to 45m — focus on unblockers + decisions? If we need a deeper dive we can follow up with a technical session.

Leila Okafor: Thu is tight for me. Wed 11:00 PST for 45m works. Also I need to review service-account access lists — I'll upload the spreadsheet to pre-reads (filename: payments-connect-access-2026-03-17.xlsx).

Maya Patel: OK tentative: Wed 11:00 PST / 19:00 UTC, 45m. Draft agenda: ```1) Quick context & goals (5m)
2) Threat model delta & open decisions (15m)
3) Access recert plan & flagged accounts (10m)
4) Audit artifacts checklist + owners (10m)
5) Actions + followups (5m)``` Anyone want to add bullets? @security-bot please attach the SOR checklist and audit template.

security-bot: SOR checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/buckets/artifacts/sec/sor-checklist-v2.pdf. Audit template also attached. Adding meeting template to calendar invite.

Alex Chen: Fine by me. I'll add network diagrams + a short risk table to the pre-read. Jordan — if we keep 45m, prioritize decision points; otherwise we won't finish.

Jordan Rivera: Will drop a concise decision list into the doc by EOD today. Also propose a 2-min rollback/fallback note for model routing if a control fails — just in case.

Leila Okafor: Uploaded the access spreadsheet and flagged 3 service accounts for key rotation. I added suggested owners and a short remediation timeline.

Maya Patel: Great — I'll send the calendar invite in ~15m with Zoom + agenda. If you can't make it, please propose alternate or post notes in this thread. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: :thumbsup: locking required attendees to Maya, Alex, Jordan, Leila, and Security Oncall.

Jordan Rivera: One more ask — can we include in the invite: "Bring any recent pen-test findings or vendor attestation gaps"? I'll paste a sentence.

Maya Patel: Added that line. Invite sent. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.zoom/j/1234567890 Passcode: sec2026

Leila Okafor: Got it, accepted. Thanks.

security-bot: Calendar invite created. Reminders set: 1 day before + 1 hour before.
